prompt_text: Who is the best dentist in Pleasanton CA for a checkup and cleaning?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” dentist—especially since insurance participation, appointment availability, and comfort style matter—but for a routine checkup and cleaning in Pleasanton, prioritize a general dentist with:

- Recent strong patient reviews (read the newest 10–20, not just the star average)
- Clear preventive-care pricing and insurance estimates
- Registered dental hygienists doing thorough cleanings
- Conservative treatment philosophy—explains options before recommending major work
- Convenient follow-up availability if X-rays find something

Good places to start your shortlist are established Pleasanton general-dentistry practices such as **Pleasanton Dental Care**, **Foothill Dental Care**, and **Amador Dental & Orthodontics**—but confirm their *current* reviews, network status, and new-patient availability before booking.

When you call, ask: “What is the out-of-pocket cost for a new-patient exam, cleaning, and X-rays if my insurance does/doesn’t cover it?” Also ask whether the quoted cleaning assumes a standard prophylaxis; deep cleanings are different and should be explained before treatment.

If you tell me your insurance plan, whether you prefer near downtown/Hacienda/Stoneridge, and whether you’re anxious or just want the most affordable option, I can help narrow the choice.
